fixture: DnR test ground truth 10086, seconds 8-12, mono, 44100 Hz
scope: One real mixture with separate music, speech and effects references; not a general benchmark or a Seedance-specific guarantee.
method: Official TIGER-DnR chunk grid (12 s window, 4 s hop, mean of 3 estimates per sample) with reflected-audio padding of 8 s on both ends instead of the official zero padding. Subtract estimated music from the mixture. SDR = 10 log10(reference energy / error energy), without scale alignment.
limitations: Residual music and some dialogue/effect loss remain. These values do not imply perfect separation.
